content:
Has anyone else encountered an issue where the citation metadata blocks for the root dataverse cannot be hidden? Geospatial metadata and custom metadata blocks can be hidden. However, when I click the checkboxes for the metadata blocks I see a 500 error. When I click the Done button the browser window freezes up and the developer window shows a javascript error. If I try to Save the page I get a 500 nginx error.

Also, I can add datasets just fine but if I try to edit and save (even without making any changes on the edit page) the browser window freezes and shows the same error.
A 500 error? Yikes. Sounds like a bug. Do you have a stacktrace from server.log?

Strangely, I'm not seeing it in the live log. The Chrome developer window is pointing to jquery.js.xhtml?ln=primefaces&v=11.0.0. The line is

r.send(i.hasContent && i.data || null)
What version of Dataverse are you on, please?
And it only happens on the root collection? You can't reproduce it on a subcollection?
I'm asking because if you can reproduce it on a subcollection, I'd love for you to try to reproduce it on https://demo.dataverse.org which is running 6.12.1.
I was able to reproduce the error on a subcollection. I'll try it with the Harvard dataverse demo site
I have been unable to reproduce the issue on demo.dataverse.org.
